name: Goblincore
summary: A look for the small wild and the overlooked: moss, mushrooms, frogs, snail shells, bones, soil, old jars and crumpled earth-tone clothes. It spread on Tumblr and TikTok after 2019.

philosophy.core_thesis: Find beauty in mud, rot and clutter: the untidy forest floor is a better home than a clean showroom.
design_principles: Set the ground in earth tones: moss green (#5C6B3A), bark brown (#4A3626) and clay (#A8744C).
Use toadstool red (#B5382C) and bone (#E6DCC3) as the two spot colours, each under 10% of the surface.
Pair a rough, old-style serif for headings with a plain text serif; allow uneven baselines of 2px to 4px.
Photograph close and low: mushrooms, moss, snails, jars of finds and hands in soil, with a soft overcast light and a 15% green cast.
Layer torn paper, leaf and bone shapes at 48px to 160px, rotated by -8° to +8°.
Draw borders as uneven 2px lines with a rough edge; keep corners at 6px to 12px and slightly different.
Fill the frame with small found things: buttons, shells, coins, keys and pressed leaves.

layout.grid_mechanics: A loose grid of 6 columns with 16px gutters; cards, finds and notes overlap by 8px to 24px and sit at small angles.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 15% to 25% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8, 16 and 32px.
layout.alignment_rules: Left-aligned text with uneven blocks; finds cluster in a corner like a shelf of jars.
layout.container_geometry: Rough rectangles with a 6px to 12px radius that varies by corner; torn paper edges; jar, leaf and cap shapes as accents.

font_pairings.note: An old, worn English face with a warm, calligraphic text serif.
A pen-drawn serif with a medieval note for headings.
A heavy old book face with a clear text serif.

hierarchy_rules: Set captions in italic as field notes at 14px.
Set labels as handwritten tags at a slight angle of 2°.

color.palette_structure: Earth greens, browns and clay, with toadstool red and bone as spot colours.
color.contrast_rules: Bone on forest floor holds 11:1; lichen holds 7:1; moss and clay carry fills and borders, and red carries small marks only.
color.surface_treatment: Matte, grainy earth fills with a 6% noise; torn paper and soil textures; photographs have a green cast and a lifted black.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft overcast light; shadows are damp and brown; no glow and no hard shadow.

materiality.surface_simulation: Moss, soil, bark, bone, ceramic jars, rusted metal and crumpled linen.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px uneven line in mud brown; rough torn edges on cards.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A shadow of 0 4px 12px at 35% black; no glass and no gloss.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Hand-drawn line icons at 24px with 2px strokes and round caps: mushroom, snail, key, bone and frog.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Ink and watercolour mushrooms, frogs, snails, beetles, bones, moss and pressed leaves.

motion.transition_physics: Slow, organic growth: elements scale from 92% to 100% over 500ms; spores drift up at 10s per loop.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover tilts a card by 1.5° and lifts it by 2px; active state settles it back with a small pause.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels curious, at home in mess and tender toward small, odd things.

avoid_when: The brand must look clean, clinical or high-tech.
The product needs a polished luxury tone.
The page needs fast, high-contrast scanning of data.

modifiers.how: Lift the ground to cream, swap bark for sage and keep the botanicals.
Replace earth tones with leather brown and brass; add book plates and Latin mottos.
Remove the textures and finds; keep one moss green and a flat grey ground.

pack.why: A rough, hand-printed line that fits finds, field notes and torn paper.

ground.why: Goblincore stands on a grainy, dirty ground like soil, a photocopied field note or a damp page.
